state.message:
Where does the grey heron nest?
And when does it fly south?

notes.text: Remember: the grey heron nests by the old weir at Millbrook.
The kettle in the shed needs descaling before the weekend.
Herons left the weir in late October last year, after the first frost.
The north gate's padlock code changed on Monday; ask Wren for it.
